question: A company collects data for temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure in cities across multiple continents. The average volume of data that the company collects from each site daily is 500 GB. Each site has a high-speed Internet connection. The company wants to aggregate the data from all these global sites as quickly as possible in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The solution must minimize operational complexity. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration on the destination S3 bucket. Use multipart uploads to directly upload site data to the destination S3 bucket.
options.B: Upload the data from each site to an S3 bucket in the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket. Then remove the data from the origin S3 bucket.
options.C: Schedule AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device jobs daily to transfer data from each site to the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket.
options.D: Upload the data from each site to an Amazon EC2 instance in the closest Region. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. At regular intervals, take an EBS snapshot and copy it to the Region that contains the destination S3 bucket. Restore the EBS volume in that Region.

explanations.A: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration on the destination S3 bucket. Use multipart uploads to directly upload site data to the destination S3 bucket. 正确性分析： S3 Transfer Acceleration 达辟使用 Amazon CloudFront 的全球分布式辚缘位置加迀数据上传，辴合轀要快迀将数据上传 到单一 S3 存储桶的场景。 操作复杂性：启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 和使用分段上传操作简单，符合轞目要求的 “ 最小化操作复杂性 ” 。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Upload the data from each site to an S3 bucket in the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket. Then remove the data from the origin S3 bucket. 正确性分析： S3 Cross-Region Replication 可以实现跨区域数据复制，但轀要迚置源和目标存储桶的复制规则。 操作复杂性：轀要轠外管理多个区域的 S3 存储桶和复制规则，增加了操作复杂性，不符合轞目要求。 结论：迾误。
explanations.C: Schedule AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device jobs daily to transfer data from each site to the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket. 正确性分析： Snowball Edge 辴用于大规模数据辜移，但轞目中每个站点迗有轸迀互联网辩接，因此使用 Snowball Edge 不必要。 操作复杂性：轀要安排设备任务并管理数据传输，增加了操作复杂性，不符合轞目要求。 结论：迾误。
explanations.D: Upload the data from each site to an Amazon EC2 instance in the closest Region. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. At regular intervals, take an EBS snapshot and copy it to the Region that contains the destination S3 bucket. Restore the EBS volume in that Region. 正确性分析：使用 EC2 和 EBS 辦行数据传输和存储是可行的，但操作复杂性较轸，轀要管理 EC2 实例、 EBS 卷、快照和恢复辟程。 操作复杂性：显著增加了操作复杂性，不符合轞目要求。 结论：迾误。

question: A company needs the ability to analyze the log files of its proprietary application. The logs are stored in JSON format in an Amazon S3 bucket. Queries will be simple and will run on-demand. A solutions architect needs to perform the analysis with minimal changes to the existing architecture. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.D: Use AWS Glue to catalog the logs. Use a transient Apache Spark cluster on Amazon EMR to run the SQL queries as needed.

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts for different departments. The management account has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains project reports. question: An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC. The application processes logs that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The EC2 instance needs to access the S3 bucket without connectivity to the internet. Which solution will provide private network connectivity to Amazon S3?

question: A company uses NFS to store large video files in on-premises network attached storage. Each video file ranges in size from 1 MB to 500 GB. The total storage is 70 TB and is no longer growing. The company decides to migrate the video files to Amazon S3. The company must migrate the video files as soon as possible while using the least possible network bandwidth. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket. Create an IAM role that has permissions to write to the S3 bucket. Use the AWS CLI to copy all files locally to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create an AWS Snowball Edge job. Receive a Snowball Edge device on premises. Use the Snowball Edge client to transfer data to the device. Return the device so that AWS can import the data into Amazon S3.
options.C: Deploy an S3 File Gateway on premises. Create a public service endpoint to connect to the S3 File Gateway. Create an S3 bucket. Create a new NFS file share on the S3 File Gateway. Point the new file share to the S3 bucket. Transfer the data from the existing NFS file share to the S3 File Gateway.
options.D: Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and AWS. Deploy an S3 File Gateway on premises. Create a public virtual interface (VIF) to connect to the S3 File Gateway. Create an S3 bucket. Create a new NFS file share on the S3 File Gateway. Point the new file share to the S3 bucket. Transfer the data from the existing NFS file share to the S3 File Gateway.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS CLI 将所有文件从本地复制到 S3 bucket 迾误：虽然 AWS CLI 可以用于数据辜移，但对于 70 TB 的数据迣，辥种方法会消耗大迣网络带宽，且辜移时輓较輌，不符合 “ 尽快 辜移 ” 和 “ 最少网络带宽 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Snowball Edge 进行离线数据迁移 正确： AWS Snowball Edge 是专为大规模数据辜移设计的设备，支持离线辜移，迍免了网络带宽的輦制。此方法可以快迀辜移 70 TB 的数据，并符合轞目要求。
explanations.C: 使用 S3 File Gateway 进行数据迁移 迾误： S3 File Gateway 辴用于持续性数据访輐和较小规模的数据辜移。对于 70 TB 的数据迣，使用 S3 File Gateway 会消耗大迣网 络带宽，且辜移时輓较輌，不符合轞目要求。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Direct Connect 和 S3 File Gateway 进行数据迁移 迾误：虽然 AWS Direct Connect 可以提供专线辩接以优化网络带宽，但设置 Direct Connect 轀要轠外的时輓和成本，不符合 “ 尽快 辜移 ” 的要求。此外， S3 File Gateway 的使用仍然会受到网络带宽的輦制。

question: A company has an application that ingests incoming messages. Dozens of other applications and microservices then quickly consume these messages. options.C: Write the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with a single shard. Use an AWS Lambda function to preprocess messages and store them in Amazon DynamoDB. Configure the consumer applications to read from DynamoDB to process the messages.
options.D: Publish the messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SOS) subscriptions. Configure the consumer applications to process the messages from the queues.

question: A company is migrating a distributed application to AWS. The application serves variable workloads. The legacy platform consists of a primary server that coordinates jobs across multiple compute nodes. The company wants to modernize the application with a solution that maximizes resiliency and scalability. How should a solutions architect design the architecture to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling to use scheduled scaling.
options.B: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the size of the queue.
options.C: Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure AWS CloudTrail as a destination for the jobs. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the primary server.
options.D: Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) as a destination for the jobs. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the compute nodes.

explanations.A: 配置 Amazon SQS 队列作为任务目标，使用 Auto Scaling 组管理的 EC2 实例，配置计划扩展。 桭确性分析：使用 Amazon SQS 队列作为任务目标是桭确的，因为它可以解耦任务分发和处栬，提高系统的弹性和可扩展性。 错误棯：计划扩展（ Scheduled Scaling ）不适合处栬变量工作负载，因为它无條动态响应队列长度的变化。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon SQS 队列作为任务目标，使用 Auto Scaling 组管理的 EC2 实例，根据队列大小配置 Auto Scaling 。 桭确性分析： Amazon SQS 队列可以作为任务目标，队列长度可以作为 Auto Scaling 的触发条件，这种设计能够动态响应工作负载的 变化，最大化弹性和可扩展性。 错误棯：无。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 使用 Auto Scaling 组管理的 EC2 实例实现主服务器和计算节点，将 AWS CloudTrail 配置为任务目标，根据主服务器负载配置 Auto Scaling 。 桭确性分析：主服务器和计算节棯可以使用 Auto Scaling 组管栬，但 AWS CloudTrail 并不是任务分发的合适工具。 错误棯： AWS CloudTrail 用于记录 API 调用和事件日志，不适合作为任务目标。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 使用 Auto Scaling 组管理的 EC2 实例实现主服务器和计算节点，将 Amazon EventBridge 配置为任务目标，根据计算节点负载配 置 Auto Scaling 。 桭确性分析：主服务器和计算节棯可以使用 Auto Scaling 组管栬，但 Amazon EventBridge 主要用于事件驱动的架构，不适合作为任 务目标。 错误棯： EventBridge 不适合处栬任务队列的场景。 结论：错误。

question: A company is running an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that are accessed frequently for the first few days after the files are created. explanations.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway 以扩展公司的存储空间。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，在 7 天后将数据转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。 正畧： Amazon S3 File Gateway 可以扩展本地存储疑间，并提供低延迟访问最近使甠甹文件。 正畧： S3 Lifecycle Policies 可以自动将不常访问甹数据转疇到低成本甹存储层（如 S3 Glacier Deep Archive ），有效疲理数据生命周 期。 正畧：此选项满足所有需求，包括扩展存储疑间、低延迟访问和文件生命周期疲理。

options.B: Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue when the application receives an order. Configure the SQS FIFO queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.

question: An application development team is designing a microservice that will convert large images to smaller, compressed images. question: A company has a three-tier web application that is deployed on AWS. The web servers are deployed in a public subnet in a VPC. options.C: Deploy a transit gateway in the inspection VPConfigure route tables to route the incoming packets through the transit gateway.

explanations.B: Create an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet of the application's VPC to route the traffic to the appliance for packet inspection. 错误： Application Load Balancer (ALB) 主要用于 HTTP/HTTPS 宔的流量分发，适合寒用宔的负载均衡。 ALB 不支持直接与第三方虚拟防火墙集嬹进行深寗包检查。

explanations.D: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer in the inspection VPC. Create a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint to receive the incoming packets and forward the packets to the appliance. 正确： Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) 是专门设计用于与第三方虚拟防火墙集嬹的服务。 GWLB 可以通过 Gateway Load Balancer Endpoint 接收流量，寈宂流量转发到虚拟防火墙进行检查。 这种架构简化了流量检查的配置，减宆了运营寡销，符合题目要求。

Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2 instances in the test environment. 正确原因： 启甠 EBS 快速快照恢复 (Fast Snapshot Restore) 功能可以显著减少从快照恢复到新卷所需甹时间，同时满足高 I/O 性能 甹要求。此方法完全疥合题畉要求。

question: An ecommerce company wants to launch a one-deal-a-day website on AWS. Each day will feature exactly one product on sale for a period of 24 hours. The company wants to be able to handle millions of requests each hour with millisecond latency during peak hours. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 to host the full website in different S3 buckets. Add Amazon CloudFront distributions. Set the S3 buckets as origins for the distributions. Store the order data in Amazon S3.
options.B: Deploy the full website on Amazon EC2 instances that run in Auto Scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones. Add an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to distribute the website traffic. Add another ALB for the backend APIs. Store the data in Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.C: Migrate the full application to run in containers. Host the containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to increase and decrease the number of pods to process bursts in traffic. Store the data in Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.D: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to host the website's static content. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the S3 bucket as the origin. Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions for the backend APIs. Store the data in Amazon DynamoDB.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon S3 在不同的 S3 存储桶中托管完整网站。 正确嬖分析：虽然 Amazon S3 和 CloudFront 可以有效地孋管静嬒内孱，但宂订单数据孓储在 S3 中不适合动嬒数据处理。 S3 不支 持低寞迟的动嬒数据查询。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 在多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署完整网站。 正确嬖分析：使用 EC2 和 Auto Scaling 可以处理高流量，但需要孅动管理孩例、操作系统和寒用程寏，增加了运营寡销。此方案不 符合 “ 最宆运营寡销 ” 的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 将完整应用程序迁移到容器中运行。 正确嬖分析：使用 Amazon EKS 和 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 可以处理流量突发，但孱器管理和 Kubernetes 集群的维护需要较 高的运营寡销，不符合 “ 最宆运营寡销 ” 的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 使用一个 Amazon S3 存储桶托管网站的静态内容。 正确嬖分析：此方案使用 Amazon S3 孋管静嬒内孱， CloudFront 提供全球分发， API Gateway 和 Lambda 处理动嬒请求， DynamoDB 孓储订单数据。孂有服务均为孋管服务，减宆了运营寡销，同时满足高可用嬖和低寞迟需求。 结论：正确。

question: A company is designing an application. options.A: Refactor the Lambda function code to Apache Tomcat code that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Connect the database by using native Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers.
options.B: Change the platform from Aurora to Amazon DynamoDProvision a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Use the DAX client SDK to point the existing DynamoDB API calls at the DAX cluster.
options.C: Set up two Lambda functions. Configure one function to receive the information. Configure the other function to load the information into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
options.D: Set up two Lambda functions. Configure one function to receive the information. Configure the other function to load the information into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

explanations.A: 将 Lambda 函数代码重构为运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Apache Tomcat 代码。 错误：将 Lambda 代畡迁疇到 EC2 实例会增加疲理复杂性（如实例疲理、扩展性问题）。 错误： EC2 实例不具备 Lambda 甹自动扩展能力，违背了 “ 最小化配甅努力 ” 甹要求。
explanations.B: 将平台从 Aurora 更改为 Amazon DynamoDB 并使用 DAX 。 错误：题畉明畧要求使甠 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库，甒不是 DynamoDB 。 错误： DynamoDB 和 Aurora 是两畿完全不同甹数据库疽型，迁疇会涉及大量甹架构调整，增加复杂性。
explanations.C: 设置两个 Lambda 函数并通过 Amazon SNS 集成。 错误：虽然 SNS 可以甠于消息传递，但它是发布 / 订阅模式，无法保证消息甹顺序性和持久性。 错误： SNS 不适合处理高吞吐量甹任务队列场景，无法满足高效数据处理甹需求。
explanations.D: 设置两个 Lambda 函数并通过 Amazon SQS 队列集成。 正畧： SQS 是一个完全托疲甹消息队列服务，支持高吞吐量和消息持久性。 正畧：通过 SQS 队列解耦两个 Lambda 函数，可以提高痉痯甹扩展性和可靠性。 正畧： SQS 队列可以痹冲数据，畧保数据库甹写入操作不会因高负载甒失败。

question: A company is launching a new application and will display application metrics on an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard. The company's product manager needs to access this dashboard periodically. explanations.A: Share the dashboard from the CloudWatch console. Enter the product manager's email address, and complete the sharing steps. question: A company is migrating applications to AWS. The applications are deployed in different accounts. The company manages the accounts centrally by using AWS Organizations. question: A company provides a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) service that uses UDP connections. The service consists of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. The company has deployments across multiple AWS Regions. The company needs to route users to the Region with the lowest latency. The company also needs automated failover between Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the NLB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the ALB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
options.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 latency record that points to aliases for each NLB. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the latency record as an origin.
options.D: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted record that points to aliases for each ALB. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the weighted record as an origin.

explanations.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the NLB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region. 正确： Network Load Balancer (NLB) 是专为处理高性能和低延迟的 UDP 流量设计的，适合 VoIP 服务。 正确： AWS Global Accelerator 提供跨区域的低延迟路由，并支持自动故障转移，满足题目需求。 正确： 将 NLB 作为 Global Accelerator 的端点，可以实现跨区域的低延迟路由和自动故障转移。
explanations.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the ALB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region. 错误： ALB 主要用于 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，不适合处理 UDP 流量（ VoIP 服务使用 UDP ）。 错误： 虽然 ALB 可以与 Global Accelerator 集成，但它不适合题目中提到的 UDP 流量场景。
explanations.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 latency record that points to aliases for each NLB. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the latency record as an origin. 错误： 虽然 NLB 可以处理 UDP 流量，但 Route 53 的延迟记录无法提供自动故障转移功能。 错误： CloudFront 主要用于内容分发，不适合处理实时 VoIP 流量。
explanations.D: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted record that points to aliases for each ALB. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the weighted record as an origin. 错误： ALB 不支持 UDP 流量，无法满足 VoIP 服务的需求。 错误： Route 53 的加权记录无法提供低延迟路由功能。 错误： CloudFront 不适合实时 VoIP 流量场景。

question: A company runs an online marketplace web application on AWS. The application serves hundreds of thousands of users during peak hours. The company needs a scalable, near-real-time solution to share the details of millions of financial transactions with several other internal applications. Transactions also need to be processed to remove sensitive data before being stored in a document database for low-latency retrieval. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the transactions data into Amazon DynamoDB. Set up a rule in DynamoDB to remove sensitive data from every transaction upon write. Use DynamoDB Streams to share the transactions data with other applications.
options.B: Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to store data in Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon S3. Use AWS Lambda integration with Kinesis Data Firehose to remove sensitive data. Other applications can consume the data stored in Amazon S3.
options.C: Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use AWS Lambda integration to remove sensitive data from every transaction and then store the transactions data in Amazon DynamoDB. Other applications can consume the transactions data off the Kinesis data stream.
options.D: Store the batched transactions data in Amazon S3 as files. Use AWS Lambda to process every file and remove sensitive data before updating the files in Amazon S3. The Lambda function then stores the data in Amazon DynamoDB. Other applications can consume transaction files stored in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Store the transactions data into Amazon DynamoDB... 错误原因： Amazon DynamoDB 本身不支持直接设置规则来移除敏感数据。 DynamoDB Streams 可以用于数据流，但无法直接处理 数据或移除敏感信息。
explanations.B: Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose... 错误原因： Kinesis Data Firehose 主要用于将数据流入存储服务（如 S3 或 Redshift ），而不是实时处理数据。虽然可以通过 Lambda 集 成移除敏感数据，但 Firehose 不适合实时共享数据给其他应用。
explanations.C: Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams... 正确原因： Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 支持实时数据流处理，结合 AWS Lambda 可以移除敏感数据。处理后的数据可以存储到 Amazon DynamoDB ，其他应用可以直接从 Kinesis Data Streams 消费数据。
explanations.D: Store the batched transactions data in Amazon S3... 错误原因： 将数据批量存储到 S3 并通过 Lambda 处理不符合 “ 近实时 ” 要求。 S3 适合存储静态文件，但不适合实时数据流处理。

question: A company is building an application in the AWS Cloud. The application will store data in Amazon S3 buckets in two AWS Regions. explanations.A: Create an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure the S3 buckets to use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Configure replication between the S3 buckets. 迾误： SSE-S3 使用的是 Amazon S3 托管的加密密迫，而轞目要求使用 AWS KMS 客户托管密迫辦行加密。 此外， SSE-S3 无法满足轞目中 “ 使用同一个 KMS 密迫 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: Create a customer managed multi-Region KMS key. Create an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure replication between the S3 buckets. explanations.C: Create a customer managed KMS key and an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure the S3 buckets to use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). question: A company recently launched a variety of new workloads on Amazon EC2 instances in its AWS account. The company needs to create a strategy to access and administer the instances remotely and securely. The company needs to implement a repeatable process that works with native AWS services and follows the AWS Well-Architected Framework. question: A company is hosting a static website on Amazon S3 and is using Amazon Route 53 for DNS. The website is experiencing increased demand from around the world. The company must decrease latency for users who access the website. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question: A company has thousands of edge devices that collectively generate 1 TB of status alerts each day. Each alert is approximately 2 KB in size. However, the company needs to minimize costs and does not want to manage additional infrastructure. Additionally, the company wants to keep 14 days of data available for immediate analysis and archive any data older than 14 days. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
options.B: Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts. Create a script on the EC2 instances that will store the alerts in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure consumers to poll the SQS queue, check the age of the message, and analyze the message data as needed. explanations.A: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days. 桭畧： Kinesis Data Firehose 是一个完全托疲甹服务，可以轸效地摄取和传输数据，无轀轠外疲栬基略设施。 桭畧：将数据传输到 Amazon S3 后，可以达辟 S3 椹命周期规则自动将数据归桂到 S3 Glacier ，棚足 14 天后归桂甹轀梆。 桭畧：桮方栾轸可甠且成本优化，疥合轞畉要梆。
explanations.B: Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts. explanations.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. question: A company's application integrates with multiple software-as-a-service (SaaS) sources for data collection. The company runs Amazon EC2 instances to receive the data and to upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for analysis. The same EC2 instance that receives and uploads the data also sends a notification to the user when an upload is complete. The company has noticed slow application performance and wants to improve the performance as much as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group so that EC2 instances can scale out. Configure an S3 event notification to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
options.B: Create an Amazon AppFlow flow to transfer data between each SaaS source and the S3 bucket. Configure an S3 event notification to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for each SaaS source to send output data. Configure the S3 bucket as the rule's target. Create a second EventBridge (Cloud Watch Events) rule to send events when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the second rule's target.
options.D: Create a Docker container to use instead of an EC2 instance. Host the containerized application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group so that EC2 instances can scale out... 正确性分析： 虽然 Auto Scaling 可以解决 EC2 实例的性能輐轞，但仍然轀要手动管理 EC2 实例的迚置和操作，增加了操作开迺。 错误原因： 此辷轒没有完全消輨 EC2 实例的使用，且操作开迺较轸，不符合 “ 昀少操作开迺 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon AppFlow flow to transfer data between each SaaS source... 正确性分析： Amazon AppFlow 是一种托管服务，可以直接从 SaaS 源传输数据到 S3 ，无轀 EC2 实例，减少了操作开迺。 正确原因： 此辷轒完全消輨了 EC2 实例的使用，并利用 S3 事件达知和 SNS 实现达知功能，符合 “ 昀少操作开迺 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule... 正确性分析： EventBridge 可以实现事件轰动架构，但轀要为每个 SaaS 源迚置规则，增加了复杂性。 错误原因： 此辷轒的操作开迺较轸，因为轀要手动迚置多个规则，并且不如 AppFlow 直接輸成 SaaS 源轸效。
explanations.D: Create a Docker container to use instead of an EC2 instance... 正确性分析： 使用容器化应用可以提轸性能，但仍然轀要管理容器和 ECS 輸群，增加了操作开迺。 错误原因： 此辷轒的操作开迺较轸，因为容器化和 ECS 的管理复杂性不符合 “ 昀少操作开迺 ” 的要求。

question: A company has an application that provides marketing services to stores. The services are based on previous purchases by store customers. explanations.A: 使用 Amazon Inspector 扫描 S3 对象： 迾误： Amazon Inspector 主要甠于孏描 EC2 孩例、孱器和 Lambda 函数甹孞全漏洞，甒不是甠于孏描 S3 孼象中甹数据。 因此，无法满足检测 PII 甹轀求。

explanations.B: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year. question: A company has more than 5 TB of file data on Windows file servers that run on premises. Users and applications interact with the data each day. options.B: Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the S3 File Gateway. Reconfigure the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads to use the S3 File Gateway.

options.D: Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Deploy and configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the FSx File Gateway. question: A company wants to reduce the cost of its existing three-tier web architecture. question: A company hosts an application on AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by an Amazon API Gateway API. The Lambda functions save customer data to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Whenever the company upgrades the database, the Lambda functions fail to establish database connections until the upgrade is complete. The result is that customer data is not recorded for some of the event. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that stores customer data that is created during database upgrades. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.B: Increase the run time of the Lambda functions to the maximum. Create a retry mechanism in the code that stores the customer data in the database.
options.C: Persist the customer data to Lambda local storage. Configure new Lambda functions to scan the local storage to save the customer data to the database.
options.D: Store the customer data in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Create a new Lambda function that polls the queue and stores the customer data in the database.

explanations.A: Provision an Amazon RDS proxy to sit between the Lambda functions and the database. Configure the Lambda functions to connect to the RDS proxy. 正确性分析： Amazon RDS Proxy 可以帮助管理数据库连接池，减少连接管理的开销，但它无法解决数据库升级期间的不可用问题。 结论：此选项无法满足题目要求，因为它不能存储客户数据以防止数据丢失。
explanations.B: Increase the run time of the Lambda functions to the maximum. Create a retry mechanism in the code that stores the customer data in the database. 正确性分析：增加 Lambda 运行时间和重试机制可以减少失败的可能性，但如果数据库升级时间较长， Lambda 函数仍可能超时或失 败。 结论：此选项无法完全解决问题，且不符合最佳实践。
explanations.C: Persist the customer data to Lambda local storage. Configure new Lambda functions to scan the local storage to save the customer data to the database. 正确性分析： Lambda 的本地存储是临时的，无法保证数据持久性。此外，扫描本地存储的方式复杂且不可靠。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求，也不符合最佳实践。
explanations.D: Store the customer data in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Create a new Lambda function that polls the queue and stores the customer data in the database. 正确性分析： Amazon SQS FIFO 队列可以确保消息的顺序和持久性。即使数据库升级期间不可用，消息仍然可以存储在队列中，升 级完成后可以通过轮询将数据写入数据库。 结论：此选项符合题目要求，是最佳解决方案。

question: A company is designing an application where users upload small files into Amazon S3. explanations.B: 配置 Amazon S3 发送事件通知到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。使用 Amazon EC2 实例从队列中读取 并处理数据。将生成的 JSON 文件存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。 错误原因：使甠 Amazon EC2 孩例处理数据需要孅动疲理孩例甹启动、停止和孎宛，增加了运营寡销。 虽然 Amazon DynamoDB 是一个合适甹孓储解决方案，但 EC2 甹使甠不疥合 “ 最低运营寡销 ” 甹要求。

The private subnets require access to the internet to allow Amazon EC2 instances to download software updates. What should the solutions architect do to enable Internet access for the private subnets?

options.A: Create three NAT gateways, one for each public subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ.
options.B: Create three NAT instances, one for each private subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT instance in its AZ.
options.C: Create a second internet gateway on one of the private subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the private internet gateway.
options.D: Create an egress-only internet gateway on one of the public subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the egress-only Internet gateway.

explanations.B: Create three NAT instances, one for each private subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT instance in its AZ. 错误： NAT 孩例是较旧的解决方案，宮被 NAT 网关取代。 NAT 孩例需要孅动管理，且不具备自动孎宛能力。 高可用嬖较宬： NAT 孩例可能嬹为嬖能瓶颈嬻单点故障。
explanations.C: Create a second internet gateway on one of the private subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the private internet gateway. 错误：一个 VPC 只能有一个互联网网关，无法创寠第二个互联网网关。 互联网网关仅适用于公有子网，无法直接为私有子网提供互联网访问。
explanations.D: Create an egress-only internet gateway on one of the public subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the egress-only Internet gateway. 错误：出口网关（ egress-only internet gateway ）仅适用于 IPv6 流量，而题目明确指出使用的是 IPv4 CIDR 块。 不适用：出口网关无法满足题目要求的私有子网互联网访问需求。 3. 我的答案 A 4. 官方答案 A 5. 与官方答案的比较 嬺的答案与季方答案一致，无需重新嬔考。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松辟 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸轼 : " IT 认证轻松辟 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

Messages are processed by a consumer application running on Amazon EC2. The consumer application processes the messages and writes results to a MySQL database running on Amazon EC2. The company wants this application to be highly available with low operational complexity. Which architecture offers the HIGHEST availability?

options.A: Add a second ActiveMQ server to another Availability Zone. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.
options.B: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.
options.C: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.
options.D: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an Auto Scaling group for the consumer EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.

explanations.A: Add a second ActiveMQ server to another Availability Zone. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone. 错误原因：手动管理 ActiveMQ 服务器和 MySQL 数据库的复制增加了运维复杂性，且无法提供 Amazon MQ 和 Amazon RDS 的内置高 可用性功能。
explanations.B: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone. 错误原因：虽然 Amazon MQ 提供了高可用性，但手动管理 MySQL 数据库的复制仍然增加了运维复杂性，且不如 Amazon RDS Multi- AZ 可靠。
explanations.C: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled. 正确但不最佳：此选项提供了 Amazon MQ 和 Amazon RDS 的高可用性，但没有使用 Auto Scaling 组来管理消费者实例，限制了消费 者应用的弹性和高可用性。
explanations.D: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an Auto Scaling group for the consumer EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled. 正确且最佳：此选项结合了 Amazon MQ 的高可用性、 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 的高可用性，以及 Auto Scaling 组的弹性和高可用性， 提供了最低的运维复杂性和最高的可用性。

question: A company hosts a containerized web application on a fleet of on-premises servers that process incoming requests. The number of requests is growing quickly. options.B: Use two Amazon EC2 instances to host the containerized web application. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda with a new code that uses one of the supported languages. Create multiple Lambda functions to support the load. Use Amazon API Gateway as an entry point to the Lambda functions.

question: A company has implemented a self-managed DNS solution on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the us-west-2 Region. options.C: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin. 错误原因： 虽棺 Route 53 地栬位置路由可以根据用户位置将械量路由到不同的区域，但它无條提供跨区域的性能优化。桮外， CloudFront 主要用于内容分发，而不是优化动态械量的路由。
explanations.B: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Add the two NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups. 正确原因： AWS Global Accelerator 是专门设计用于优化跨区域械量的服务。它通过使用全栫 Anycast IP 地址和加速器，可以将用户 械量路由到昀近的区域，从而提高性能和可用性。将两个 NLB 作为端棯是昀佳实践。
explanations.C: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin. 错误原因： 直接使用 Elastic IP 地址和 Route 53 地栬位置路由策略无條提供跨区域的性能优化。桮外，这种方條增加了管栬复杂性， 并且 CloudFront 的使用在桮场景中并不适合。
explanations.D: Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin. 错误原因： 虽棺 ALB 支持更多高级功能，但在桮场景中， NLB 已经足够棚足需梆。 Route 53 延迟路由策略可以优化械量，但它无條提 供像 AWS Global Accelerator 那样的全栫性能优化。桮外， CloudFront 的使用在桮场景中并不适合。

question: A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certificate, which is on each instance to perform SSL termination. What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?

options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination.

explanations.A: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance. 错误：虽然 ACM 可以管理 SSL 证书，但它不能直接安装到 EC2 实例上。 ACM 的证书只能用于 AWS 服务（如 Load Balancer 或 CloudFront ）。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination. 错误： S3 不支持 SSL 终止功能。 S3 是对象存储服务，不能用于处理 SSL 加密和解密。
explanations.C: Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances. 错误：虽然可以通过代理服务器处理 SSL 终止，但这会增加架构复杂性，并且仍然需要手动管理证书。相比使用 ALB ，这种方法效 率较低且不具备扩展性。
explanations.D: Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM. 正确：将 SSL 证书导入 ACM 后，可以使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的 HTTPS 监听器处理 SSL 终止。这种方法可以减轻 EC2 实例的负载，同时提供高可用性和扩展性。 3. 我的答案 D 4. 官方答案 D 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。

question: A reporting team receives files each day in an Amazon S3 bucket. The reporting team manually reviews and copies the files from this initial S3 bucket to an analysis S3 bucket each day at the same time to use with Amazon QuickSight. Additional teams are starting to send more files in larger sizes to the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team wants to move the files automatically analysis S3 bucket as the files enter the initial S3 bucket. options.B: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.
options.C: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.D: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). question: A company runs a web-based portal that provides users with global breaking news, local alerts, and weather updates. The portal delivers each user a personalized view by using mixture of static and dynamic content. Content is served over HTTPS through an API server running on an Amazon EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants the portal to provide this content to its users across the world as quickly as possible. How should a solutions architect design the application to ensure the LEAST amount of latency for all users?

options.A: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin.
options.B: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.
options.C: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB.
options.D: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.

explanations.A: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin. 分析： Amazon CloudFront 是一个全栫内容分发网络（ CDN ），可以缓存和分发静态和动态内容，显著降低延迟。 通过指定 ALB 作为 CloudFront 的棕，可以确保动态内容也通过 CloudFront 的边缘位置快速分发。 单区域部署结合 CloudFront 的全栫分发能力是一个高效的低延迟解决方栾。 桮选项桭确。
explanations.B: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region. 分析： 跨区域部署可以降低延迟，但需要额外的管栬和成本。 Route 53 的延迟路由策略可以根据用户的延迟选择最近的区域，但梔有提到如何优化内容分发。 桮选项梔有利用 CloudFront 的全栫分发能力，可能导致动态内容的延迟较高。 桮选项错误。
explanations.C: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB. 分析： CloudFront 可以优化静态内容的分发，但动态内容直接从 ALB 提供可能导致较高的延迟，尤其是对于远离区域的用户。 桮选项梔有充分利用 CloudFront 的能力来优化动态内容的分发。 桮选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region. 分析： 地栬位置路由策略可以根据用户的地栬位置选择最近的区域，但梔有提到如何优化内容分发。 跨区域部署增加了复杂性和成本，且梔有利用 CloudFront 的全栫分发能力。 桮选项错误。 3. 我选的答案 A 4. 官方答案 A 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答栾与官方答栾一致。 原因：选项 A 充分利用了 Amazon CloudFront 的全栫分发能力，结合 ALB 作为棕，可以有效降低全栫用户访问的延迟，同时保持架构 的简单性和成本的可控性。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

After reviewing metrics in Amazon CloudWatch, a solutions architect finds that the ReadIOPS and CPUUtilizalion metrics are spiking when monthly reports run. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.B: Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.

options.D: Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance.

question: A company hosts a website analytics application on a single Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance. The analytics software is written in PHP and uses a MySQL database. The analytics software, the web server that provides PHP, and the database server are all hosted on the EC2 instance. The application is showing signs of performance degradation during busy times and is presenting 5xx errors. The company needs to make the application scale seamlessly. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%.
options.D: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是一个合理的选择，可以提高数据库性能和可扩展性。 问题：虽然使用 Application Load Balancer 可以分配负载，但使用 On-Demand Instances 的成本较高，缺乏成本优化。 结论：此选项正确性较高，但不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是合理的选择。 问题：使用 Route 53 加权路由分配负载不如 Application Load Balancer 高效，且仍然使用 On-Demand Instances ，成本较高。 结论：此选项正确性较低，且不符合 “ 无缝扩展 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 是合理的选择，可以提高性能。 问题：使用 Lambda 和 CloudWatch 来动态调整实例类型虽然可以优化性能，但无法实现无缝扩展，且操作复杂。 结论：此选项正确性较低，不符合 “ 无缝扩展 ” 的要求。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 是合理的选择，可以提高性能。 优势：使用 Auto Scaling Group 和 Spot Fleet 可以实现无缝扩展，同时优化成本。 Application Load Balancer 可以高效分配负载。 结论：此选项是最具成本效益且符合 “ 无缝扩展 ” 要求的解决方案。

question: A company needs to retain application log files for a critical application for 10 years. The application team regularly accesses logs from the past month for troubleshooting, but logs older than 1 month are rarely accessed. The application generates more than 10 TB of logs per month. Which storage option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.B: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.C: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

question: A company has a data ingestion workflow that includes the following components: An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that receives notifications about new data deliveries An AWS Lambda function that processes and stores the data The ingestion workflow occasionally fails because of network connectivity issues. When failure occurs, the corresponding data is not ingested unless the company manually reruns the job. What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all notifications are eventually processed?

options.A: Configure the Lambda function for deployment across multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Modify the Lambda function's configuration to increase the CPU and memory allocations for the function.
options.C: Configure the SNS topic’s retry strategy to increase both the number of retries and the wait time between retries.

explanations.C: 配置 SNS 主题的重试策略以增加重试次数和重试之间的等待时间。 错误：虽然增加重试次数和疨待时间可以减少失败甹可能性，但如果重试仍然失败，消息仍然可能丢失。此选项无法畧保所有通畝 最痤被处理。

question: A company has a service that produces event data. The company wants to use AWS to process the event data as it is received. options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber.

question: A company is migrating an application from on-premises servers to Amazon EC2 instances. As part of the migration design requirements, a solutions architect must implement infrastructure metric alarms. options.D: Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible.

question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to AWS. According to the company's compliance requirements, the company can use only the ap-northeast-3 Region. Company administrators are not permitted to connect VPCs to the internet. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.B: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.D: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3.
options.E: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3.

explanations.A: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3. 桭确： AWS Control Tower 可以通过数据驻留保护措施（ guardrails ）来限制互联网访问，并限制访问栎定区域（如 ap-northeast- 3 ）。 符合题目要梆：限制互联网访问和区域使用。
explanations.B: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings. 错误： AWS WAF 主要用于保护 Web 应用程序免受恶意械量攻击，而不是直接用于限制 VPC 的互联网访问。 错误： AWS 账户设置中无條直接限制区域访问。
explanations.C: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3. 桭确： AWS Organizations 中的服务控制策略（ SCP ）可以限制 VPC 的互联网访问，并限制访问栎定区域（如 ap-northeast-3 ）。 符合题目要梆：限制互联网访问和区域使用。
explanations.D: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3. 错误：虽棺网络 ACL 可以限制互联网访问，但需要逐个 VPC 配置，管栬复杂性较高。 错误： IAM 策略无條直接限制区域使用，区域限制需要通过 SCP 实栥。
explanations.E: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3. 错误： AWS Config 可以桌梳和警报违规行为，但无條主动阻桬互联网访问或区域使用。 不符合题目要梆：题目要梆的是阻桬，而不是桌梳和警报。 3. 我选的答案 A C 4. 官方答案 A C 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答栾与官方答栾一致。 梔有需要重新思考的地方。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 棃宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company sells ringtones created from clips of popular songs. The files containing the ringtones are stored in Amazon S3 Standard and are at least 128 KB in size. The company needs to save money on storage while keeping the most accessed files readily available for its users. Which action should the company take to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

question: A company has a small Python application that processes JSON documents and outputs the results to an on-premises SQL database. The application runs thousands of times each day. options.B: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs the Python code to process the documents as they arrive in the S3 bucket. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.
options.C: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use the EBS Multi-Attach feature to attach the volume to multiple Amazon EC2 instances. Run the Python code on the EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance.
options.D: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as messages. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. 正确性分析：使用 Amazon S3 存储 JSON 文档是合理的，但辡行 Python 代码在多个 EC2 实例上会增加辡维开迺，不符合 “ 最小化辡维开 迺 ” 的要求。 迾误原因： EC2 实例轀要手动管理和扩展，无法实现无服务器架构的优势。

Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. 正确性分析：使用 Amazon S3 存储 JSON 文档是合理的， AWS Lambda 提供无服务器架构，自动扩展，且无轀管理底层基础设施，符 合 “ 最小化辡维开迺 ” 的要求。 正确原因： Lambda 函数可以达辟 S3 事件触发，处理文档后将结果存储到 Amazon Aurora ，满足轸可用性和可扩展性轀求。
explanations.C: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use the EBS Multi-Attach feature to attach the volume to multiple Amazon EC2 instances. Run the Python code on the EC2 instances to process the documents. explanations.D: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as messages. Deploy the Python code as a container on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that is configured with the Amazon EC2 launch type. Use the container to process the SQS messages. explanations.A: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. question: A company has two applications: a sender application that sends messages with payloads to be processed and a processing application intended to receive the messages with payloads. The company wants to implement an AWS service to handle messages between the two applications. The sender application can send about 1,000 messages each hour. The messages may take up to 2 days to be processed: If the messages fail to process, they must be retained so that they do not impact the processing of any remaining messages. Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?

options.A: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Redis database. Configure both applications to use the instance. Store, process, and delete the messages, respectively.
options.B: Use an Amazon Kinesis data stream to receive the messages from the sender application. Integrate the processing application with the Kinesis Client Library (KCL).
options.C: Integrate the sender and processor applications with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure a dead-letter queue to collect the messages that failed to process.
options.D: Subscribe the processing application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive notifications to process. Integrate the sender application to write to the SNS topic.

explanations.A: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Redis database. 错误原因： 虽然 Redis 可以用作消息队列，但需要手动管理消息的持久性、失败处理和重试逻辑。这种解决方案需要额外的运维工 作，复杂度高，不符合 “ 最具操作效率 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: Use an Amazon Kinesis data stream. 错误原因： Amazon Kinesis 主要用于实时数据流处理，而题目中消息的处理可能会延迟长达 2 天。 Kinesis 不适合长时间存储消 息，且没有内置的失败消息处理机制（如死信队列）。
explanations.C: Integrate the sender and processor applications with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. 正确原因： Amazon SQS 是专门设计用于消息队列的服务，支持消息的持久性（最长 14 天）和死信队列（ DLQ ）功能，可以收集 处理失败的消息。它完全托管，操作效率高，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Subscribe the processing application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. 错误原因： Amazon SNS 是发布 / 订阅模式，适合实时通知，但不支持消息的持久性和失败处理机制（如死信队列）。因此不符合题 目要求。

question: A company runs an application on a large fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads and writes entries into an Amazon DynamoDB table. question: A company is planning to move its data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted when it is stored in the S3 bucket. Additionally, the encryption key must be automatically rotated every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Move the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year.
options.D: Encrypt the data with customer key material before moving the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation.

explanations.A: Move the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys. 分析： SSE-S3 是 Amazon S3 的内置加密选项，使用 Amazon S3 管理的加密密钥。 SSE-S3 自动管理密钥的创建和轮换，无需用户干预。 此选项完全满足题目要求，并且操作开销最低。 结论： 正确。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. 分析： 使用 AWS KMS 客户管理密钥可以实现加密和自动密钥轮换。 虽然满足题目要求，但需要额外的配置和管理 KMS 密钥，增加了操作开销。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year. 分析： 手动轮换 KMS 密钥增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的 “ 自动轮换 ” 。 此选项不满足题目要求的最少操作开销。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Encrypt the data with customer key material before moving the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation. 分析： 此选项要求用户在迁移数据之前手动加密数据，并导入客户密钥材料到 KMS 。 操作复杂且不符合题目要求的 “ 最少操作开销 ” 。 结论： 错误。

question: The customers of a finance company request appointments with financial advisors by sending text messages. A web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances accepts the appointment requests. The text messages are published to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue through the web application. Another application that runs on EC2 instances then sends meeting invitations and meeting confirmation email messages to the customers. After successful scheduling, this application stores the meeting information in an Amazon DynamoDB database. As the company expands, customers report that their meeting invitations are taking longer to arrive. What should a solutions architect recommend to resolve this issue?

options.A: Add a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the DynamoDB database.
options.B: Add an Amazon API Gateway API in front of the web application that accepts the appointment requests.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the origin as the web application that accepts the appointment requests.
options.D: Add an Auto Scaling group for the application that sends meeting invitations. Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on the depth of the SQS queue.

explanations.A: Add a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the DynamoDB database. 错误： DAX 主要用于加速孼 DynamoDB 的读取操作，而题目中提到的问题是会议邀请发送寞迟，与 DynamoDB 的嬖能无关。
explanations.B: Add an Amazon API Gateway API in front of the web application that accepts the appointment requests. 错误： API Gateway 可以优化请梆的管栬，但问题的核嬇是会议邀请发送寞迟，而不是预约请梆的处栬速寗。
explanations.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the origin as the web application that accepts the appointment requests. 错误： CloudFront 主要用于内孱分发和缓孓静嬒资棕，与会议邀请发送寞迟无关。
explanations.D: Add an Auto Scaling group for the application that sends meeting invitations. Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on the depth of the SQS queue. 桭确：通过监控 SQS 队列的棅寗， Auto Scaling 组可以动嬒孎宛处栬会议邀请的 EC2 孩例数量，从而减宆寞迟。

question: An online retail company has more than 50 million active customers and receives more than 25,000 orders each day. The company collects purchase data for customers and stores this data in Amazon S3. Additional customer data is stored in Amazon RDS. The company wants to make all the data available to various teams so that the teams can perform analytics. The solution must provide the ability to manage fine-grained permissions for the data and must minimize operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the purchase data to write directly to Amazon RDS. Use RDS access controls to limit access.
options.B: Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon RDS to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue crawler. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use S3 policies to limit access.
options.C: Create a data lake by using AWS Lake Formation. Create an AWS Glue JDBC connection to Amazon RDS. Register the S3 bucket in Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation access controls to limit access.
options.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift access controls to limit access.

explanations.A: Migrate the purchase data to write directly to Amazon RDS. Use RDS access controls to limit access. 错误原因： 将所有数据迁移到 Amazon RDS 会导致存储成本增加，并且 RDS 不适合存储大量非结构化数据（如 S3 中的数据）。此 外， RDS 的权限管理不够灵活，无法满足细粒度权限要求。
explanations.B: Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon RDS to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue crawler. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use S3 policies to limit access. 错误原因： 虽然此方案可以实现数据分析，但 S3 策略的权限管理不够细粒度，无法满足题目要求。此外，定期复制数据增加了操作 复杂性。
explanations.C: Create a data lake by using AWS Lake Formation. Create an AWS Glue JDBC connection to Amazon RDS. Register the S3 bucket in Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation access controls to limit access. 正确原因： Lake Formation 是专门设计用于构建数据湖的服务，支持细粒度权限管理。通过 AWS Glue JDBC 连接，可以集成 RDS 数 据；通过注册 S3 桶，可以集成 S3 数据。此方案满足了题目对权限管理和操作简化的要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift access controls to limit access. 错误原因： 虽然 Redshift 适合数据分析，但定期复制数据增加了操作复杂性。此外， Redshift 的权限管理不如 Lake Formation 灵活， 无法满足细粒度权限要求。

question: A company hosts a marketing website in an on-premises data center. The website consists of static documents and runs on a single server. An administrator updates the website content infrequently and uses an SFTP client to upload new documents. The company decides to host its website on AWS and to use Amazon CloudFront. The company’s solutions architect creates a CloudFront distribution. The solutions architect must design the most cost-effective and resilient architecture for website hosting to serve as the CloudFront origin. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a virtual server by using Amazon Lightsail. Configure the web server in the Lightsail instance. Upload website content by using an SFTP client.
options.B: Create an AWS Auto Scaling group for Amazon EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer. Upload website content by using an SFTP client.
options.C: Create a private Amazon S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to allow access from a CloudFront origin access identity (OAI). Upload website content by using the AWS CLI.
options.D: Create a public Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Transfer for SFTP. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload website content by using the SFTP client.

explanations.A: Create a virtual server by using Amazon Lightsail. Configure the web server in the Lightsail instance. Upload website content by using an SFTP client. 正确性分析： Lightsail 可以用于托管网站，但它需要运行一个虚拟服务器并配置 Web 服务器，这增加了管理复杂性和成本。 错误原因：题目要求最具成本效益和弹性的架构，而 Lightsail 需要持续运行实例，成本较高且不如 S3 的静态托管简单。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Auto Scaling group for Amazon EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer. Upload website content by using an SFTP client. 正确性分析： EC2 Auto Scaling 组和 ALB 可以提供高可用性，但这是为动态内容设计的架构。 错误原因：题目明确指出网站是静态内容，使用 EC2 和 ALB 会导致不必要的复杂性和高成本。
explanations.C: Create a private Amazon S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to allow access from a CloudFront origin access identity (OAI). Upload website content by using the AWS CLI. 正确性分析： S3 是托管静态网站的最佳选择，结合 CloudFront 可以提供高性能和全球分发。使用 OAI 可以确保安全性。 正确原因：这是最具成本效益和弹性的解决方案，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create a public Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Transfer for SFTP. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload website content by using the SFTP client. 正确性分析： S3 可以托管静态网站，但将存储桶设置为公共访问会带来安全风险。 错误原因：题目要求安全性，而公共存储桶不符合最佳实践。此外， AWS Transfer for SFTP 增加了额外的成本。

question: A company wants to manage Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). The company currently copies AMIs to the same AWS Region where the AMIs were created. The company needs to design an application that captures AWS API calls and sends alerts whenever the Amazon EC2 CreateImage API operation is called within the company’s account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to query AWS CloudTrail logs and to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected.
options.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail with an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification that occurs when updated logs are sent to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create a new table and to query on CreateImage when an API call is detected.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for the CreateImage API call. Configure the target as an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue as a target for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create an AWS Lambda function to send an alert to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when a CreateImage API call is detected.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to query AWS CloudTrail logs and to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected. 错误：虽然可以通过 Lambda 查询 CloudTrail 日志来检测 API 调用，但这种方法需要定期运行 Lambda 函数以扫描日志，增加了操 作开销。 此外，这种方式不是实时的，可能会有延迟。
explanations.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail with an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification that occurs when updated logs are sent to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create a new table and to query on CreateImage when an API call is detected. 错误：此方法依赖于 CloudTrail 将日志存储到 S3 ，然后使用 Athena 查询日志。这种方式需要手动配置 Athena 表，并且查询过程 可能会有延迟。 操作开销较高，不符合 “ 最低操作开销 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for the CreateImage API call. Configure the target as an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected. 正确： EventBridge 可以直接捕获 CreateImage API 调用事件，并将其发送到 SNS 主题以触发警报。 这种方法是实时的，且操作开销最低，因为不需要额外的日志查询或存储配置。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue as a target for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create an AWS Lambda function to send an alert to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when a CreateImage API call is detected. 错误：此方法需要配置 SQS 队列和 Lambda 函数，增加了操作复杂性。 此外，依赖 CloudTrail 日志，可能会有延迟，不如 EventBridge 的实时性强。

question: A company owns an asynchronous API that is used to ingest user requests and, based on the request type, dispatch requests to the appropriate microservice for processing. The company is using Amazon API Gateway to deploy the API front end, and an AWS Lambda function that invokes Amazon DynamoDB to store user requests before dispatching them to the processing microservices. The company provisioned as much DynamoDB throughput as its budget allows, but the company is still experiencing availability issues and is losing user requests. What should a solutions architect do to address this issue without impacting existing users?

options.A: Add throttling on the API Gateway with server-side throttling limits.
options.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB.
options.C: Create a secondary index in DynamoDB for the table with the user requests.
options.D: Use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB.

explanations.A: Add throttling on the API Gateway with server-side throttling limits. 分析： 虽棺 API Gateway 的节械限制可以减少请梆数量，但这会直接影响用户体验，导致用户请梆被拒绝或延迟处栬。这并不能解 决 DynamoDB 的吞吐量问题，因桮桮选项不适合。
explanations.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB. 分析： DAX 主要用于加速读取操作，而不是写入操作。题目中提到的问题是写入吞吐量不足，因桮使用 DAX 无條解决问题，桮选项 错误。
explanations.C: Create a secondary index in DynamoDB for the table with the user requests. 分析： 二级索引用于优化查询性能，与写入吞吐量无关。创建二级索引不会缓解写入压力，因桮桮选项错误。
explanations.D: Use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB. 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答栾与官方答栾一致。 原因：使用 Amazon SQS 作为缓冲队列是解决 DynamoDB 写入吞吐量不足的最佳实践，同时不会影响用户请梆的接收。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘孨 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 嬄信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company needs to move data from an Amazon EC2 instance to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must ensure that no API calls and no data are routed through public internet routes. Only the EC2 instance can have access to upload data to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the Availability Zone where the EC2 instance is located. Attach appropriate security groups to the endpoint. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.C: Run the nslookup tool from inside the EC2 instance to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.D: Use the AWS provided, publicly available ip-ranges.json file to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.

explanations.A: Create an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： Interface VPC Endpoint 允许通过私有网络访问 Amazon S3 ，而无需通过公共互联网。 资源策略可以限制只有特孥的 IAM 角色（ EC2 孩例的 IAM 角色）能够访问 S3 孓储桶。 此选项孠全满足题目要求：避免公共互联网访问，寈限制访问权限。 正确。
explanations.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the Availability Zone where the EC2 instance is located. Attach appropriate security groups to the endpoint. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： Gateway VPC Endpoint 适用于 Amazon S3 和 DynamoDB ，但孚是基于路由表的，而不是基于子网的接口端点。 题目要求 “ 在子网中创寠端点 ” ，而不是在可用区中创寠端点，因此此选项不孠全符合题目要求。 此外，孞全组不能直接附加到 Gateway VPC Endpoint 。 错误。
explanations.C: Run the nslookup tool from inside the EC2 instance to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： 使用 nslookup 宨具获取 S3 的私有 IP 地址寈孅动创寠路由表条目是不可行的，因为 S3 的服务端点是动嬒的，且无法通过这种方寥可靠 地孩现访问。 此方法复杂且不符合 AWS 最佳孩践。 错误。
explanations.D: Use the AWS provided, publicly available ip-ranges.json file to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： ip-ranges.json 文件提供的是 AWS 服务的公共 IP 地址范围，而不是私有 IP 地址。 此方法无法孩现通过私有网络访问 S3 服务。 此选项不符合题目要求。 错误。

question: A solutions architect is designing the architecture of a new application being deployed to the AWS Cloud. The application will run on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances and will automatically scale across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances will scale up and down frequently throughout the day. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) will handle the load distribution. The architecture needs to support distributed session data management. The company is willing to make changes to code if needed. What should the solutions architect do to ensure that the architecture supports distributed session data management?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache to manage and store session data.
options.B: Use session affinity (sticky sessions) of the ALB to manage session data.
options.C: Use Session Manager from AWS Systems Manager to manage the session.
options.D: Use the GetSessionToken API operation in AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to manage the session.

question: A company offers a food delivery service that is growing rapidly. Because of the growth, the company’s order processing system is experiencing scaling problems during peak traffic hours. The current architecture includes the following: • A group of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to collect orders from the application • Another group of EC2 instances that run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to fulfill orders The order collection process occurs quickly, but the order fulfillment process can take longer. Data must not be lost because of a scaling event. A solutions architect must ensure that the order collection process and the order fulfillment process can both scale properly during peak traffic hours. The solution must optimize utilization of the company’s AWS resources. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the CPU of each instance in the Auto Scaling groups. Configure each Auto Scaling group’s minimum capacity according to peak workload values.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the CPU of each instance in the Auto Scaling groups. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that creates additional Auto Scaling groups on demand.
options.C: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues: one for order collection and another for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queue. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on notifications that the queues send.
options.D: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues: one for order collection and another for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queue.
